subject: design/feature-draft-local-git
statement: New feature contracts use drafts. In repositories whose legacy document gate remains enabled for cutover, that gate refuses new-feature work proposed as PRD ledger entries, technical designs, brainstorm records, or review reports with the feature-draft remedy, including already-open proposals; plans and permitted amendments or successors for existing document-pipeline features remain accepted (`prd:feature-draft/FR-55`, `UB-14`). Applicability is read through the existing trusted-repository policy, not a candidate-selected exemption or a new draft-mode setting.
